title: Numerical Backreaction and Finite-Time Energy Transfer in Post-Recombination Magnetogenesis from Ultralight Dark Matter
summary: We study gauge-field production in a post-recombination magnetogenesis scenario driven by an ultralight pseudoscalar dark matter field $φ$ coupled to electromagnetism. Previous analytical work has shown that a homogeneous oscillating $φ$ background can excite gauge field modes through tachyonic and narrow-band resonance channels. Here we follow the coupled evolution of the homogeneous $φ$ mode and gauge field modes of both helicities in an expanding background.
